Questions

Before you grab it

Is this the same as working with Ash 1:1?

No. The Playbook is the self-paced version of the first three pillars. If you want Ash in your corner, you can apply for coaching once you’re inside.

I’m not job hunting yet. Is it still useful?

Yes. Getting clear and updating your story before you need it is what makes the next move easier.

How long does it take?

Most of it fits into a weekend. Do it in one go or a pillar at a time.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Start here and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.
